package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `python`,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

def main():
    pass
`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Language)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Imports)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Imports[0].Source)
}
